answer: 2-of-3 threshold signing: each key is a Shamir split, one share per unrelated signer bonded at 20,000 POA. A fresh account splits its key and mails one share to each of three signers. To post, it whispers the draft to two who check the bond and countersign. A colluding signer loses its bond; keys whose shares always travel together die. Forging 5,000 identities needs two captured signers each: 10,000 bribed signatures an epoch, three operators, 60,000 POA slashable, 30 clean days before payout. Three junipers on three knolls: a voyage must reach two at once, and the third sees it coming.
